Exercise C

Writing: Your Own Online Review

Write an online review (6–8 sentences) of a film, game, restaurant or product you know. Say what it is, what you liked or disliked, and whether you recommend it.

Useful review language
You can use these: I would recommend in my opinion the best thing the only problem reliable disappointing excellent overall five stars
Your review
Aim for 6–8 sentences. Give a clear opinion and a recommendation.
